title: BuildRequest v1
description: Complete, self-contained build input accepted by the CLI and by any future HTTP service. Extra properties are rejected everywhere.

generator.description: Closed enum of trusted, reviewed generators. Callers cannot supply code.

print_profile.description: Printer constraints. These drive both generation minimums and pass/fail QA thresholds, so a model built for a 0.4 mm FDM nozzle is validated against 0.4 mm FDM rules.

output_profile.description: complete-v1 publishes the full artifact tree. print-only-v1 skips renders for fast headless batches.

quality_profile.description: geometry-v1 fails the build when a required print check fails. advisory-v1 records the same measurements but only warns.
